body:
I rolled for the first time in August 04'.  I was 23.  I'm 5'8 and am in good shape due to regular exercise.  I am not a regular user of any drugs other than caffeine, nicotine, and alcohol.  The tab was white with a camel stamped onto it.  It hit me in about fifteen minutes and was mild for only a couple of minutes and then I was up.  I was up for about 4 hours of Magic Time and came down peacfully of the next two hours with only the urge to do more or get high as a negative.  I was sitting in the middle of a kitchen while a party went on around me.  I watched people and wrote and people came by to talk to me and give me water.  It went well.  Every little noise felt interconnected and melodious.
One week later I'm at a party with a lot of the people I was around when I initially rolled and I had had one glass of beer, then, all of a sudden I started to feel ill and proceeded to vomit.  After vomiting I started feeling all warm and fuzzy and my friends started asking me if I was rolling again because I was grinning ear to ear and my pupils had gone to flying saucer size.  After ensuring my friends that I didn't have any pills, the thought occured that I was re-rolling ... something like a flash-back.  It lasted for four more hours and then I was completely worn out.  Two weeks later I had another slight, less than the last one, re-roll, no negative effects.  It lasted almost two hours.  For all of these events, except for the initial time, there was no build up of feeling.  It was wham bam Magic Time.  Every once in a while I'll be sitting around and all of a sudden its Magic Time.  These only last for a minute or two, but my eyes go big and my senses are perky and my body just tingles with every breeze.  I only done the one tab.  I've never taken again.  These long term effects are cool and all, but I sometimes wonder what the tab was.  I got it from a friend that I trust.  He gets them from some bloke he knows in another state.  The tab may have had some extra other interesting ingredients.  None of the people I've spoken to have ever seen a white double stack with a camel stamped into it.
